name: web-fatis-the-problem-banner-with-faded-sketch-illustration
title: 'The Problem' case study banner with a faded pink sketch of a stressed face and laptop
whatItIs: A wide beige banner with a hot pink 'The Problem' heading and paragraph on the left and a large faded pink line sketch on the right: a worried face, a laptop showing a donut site, a question mark and a scribble.
whatItMeans: Honest but light; the doodle eases a serious section with humour.
techniques: Put a faded line illustration behind half the banner.
Use one brand colour for both text and art.
Keep the section to a heading and one paragraph.

vocabulary.definition: An image faded to sit behind content.
